name: ai-game-studio-macos
description: An opt-in macOS edition for native Codex AI Game Studio detection, planning, and platform-safe tool adaptation.

interface.shortDescription: Plan a native macOS game-creation toolchain safely.
interface.longDescription: Detects Apple Silicon or Intel macOS projects without mutation, proposes native engine and DCC routes, and adapts Windows-only or GPU-bound workflows without claiming binary compatibility.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $ai-game-studio-macos:setup-macos-edition to inspect this Mac and propose one native setup. Do not change anything yet.
